How Do I…?

Register to Vote/Change Voter Information

Register to vote or update your name, address or other voter details.

Vote in Person During Advance Voting

Cast your ballot early at a convenient Advance Voting location.

Vote in Person on Election Day

Vote at your assigned polling place on Election Day.

Find My Polling Place

Locate your assigned Election Day polling place.

Absentee Vote by Mail

Request and return your absentee ballot by mail.

View My Sample Ballot

Preview your sample ballot on My Voter Page before heading to the polls.

View Public Notices

Stay informed with official election notices and updates.

Submit/View Challenges to Voter Eligibility

Submit or review challenges to voter eligibility records.
